source.note: single-card witness of the SOUGHT HOLE 'cost-modification' (priority 1 in rollup/port-topology.cited.json holes; proposed_stem=modification:spell, kind=BEHAVIOR, slang=[tax, cost-reduction, cheat-out], note: 'both directions (up tax / down reduction) homeless'). stone-calendar.json already witnessed the DOWN (cost-reduction) direction with control=you; this gold closes the remaining UP (tax) direction the hole explicitly called out as still homeless, and does so with a card whose static ability carries NO controller filter at all — a second, structurally distinct point on the closed 'control' axis (any vs stone-calendar's you). AST is faithful, not a wish: there is an ALREADY-GREEN hand-parsed gold at Fixtures/HandParsedCards/LRW/ThornOfAmethyst.json (consumed by Tests/Parse/HandParsedCardTests.cs) — a single Ability.Kind=static with one Effect EffectType=costIncrease, Amount={QuantityType:literal, Value:1} (purely generic {1}), AffectedObjects={CardTypes:[spell], ExcludedCardTypes:[creature]} (no Controller field at all — the parser comment on NoncreatureSpellCostIncreaseRule records 'No "you cast" suffix — the tax applies to all players' noncreature spells.'). No parser work was needed for this gold: CostIncreaseEffect (libs/magic-ast/AST/Effects/Resource/CostIncreaseEffect.cs) and NoncreatureSpellCostIncreaseRule already exist and already parse this exact card. The ADR-2 layer projects the cost modifier as emit:costincrease (libs/mast-interaction/known-coarse-projections.json: 'costIncrease: baseline coarse fallback ... no flow rule consumes it yet' — the same no-flow-arm-yet state as costReduction); ADR-3 canonical stem = the bare modification:spell (the hole's proposed_stem, already status=witnessed via stone-calendar, unpredicted:true). AXIS QUESTION (surfaced, not decided — same open item stone-calendar recorded): the hole's proposed attr 'cost-delta' (direction=increase, amount={1}, currency=mana) is still NOT in the closed attribute_axes set; this gold does not invent it. Following the Boggart Brute / Stone Calendar precedent (witness the bare stem, surface the missing axis rather than invent one), this gold witnesses the bare stem with ONLY the closed 'control' axis (control=any, derived from the total absence of a Controller filter — CR 601.2f's cost increase applies to whichever spell meets AffectedObjects regardless of caster) and leaves both the cost-delta and card-type-filter axis questions for scaffold refinement. Thorn of Amethyst.note: THE WITNESS — 'Noncreature spells cost {1} more to cast' is a static continuous effect (CR 604.1, 611.2) that adjusts the total cost of casting a spell (CR 601.2f, cost increases). AST-derivable: StaticAbility with one CostIncreaseEffect{Amount=literal 1} over AffectedObjects{CardTypes=[spell], ExcludedCardTypes=[creature]} -> engine emits ADR-2 emit:costincrease -> hand-maps to the bare BEHAVIOR stem modification:spell (the hole's proposed_stem, already witnessed once by stone-calendar). control='any' is the ONLY closed axis attached, and it is the LATTICE TOP: AffectedObjects carries no Controller filter at all, so the tax binds every player's matching spells (control axis licensed_by *, lattice self ⊆ controlled ⊆ any) — the honest opposite pole from stone-calendar's control=you, corroborating that 'control' genuinely varies (not a fixed constant) on modification:spell.
